view.info.title: Information
view.info.help: This page sums up how the game works: rules, drop rates, experience and credits. The rates shown are read straight from the data files, exactly like a real draw.
view.info.subtitle: How the application works, the drop rates and the credits.
info.how.title: How does it work?
info.how.intro: MineCards is a collection game: your account, your collection and your statistics are stored in this browser only, nothing is sent to a server.
info.how.step1: Every day you get 3 free boosters. Bonus boosters can also be credited by promo codes and distributions.
info.how.step2: Pick an extension and open a booster: its 5 cards are drawn and stored immediately, before the animation.
info.how.step3: Reveal the cards one by one, then read the summary. The booster code (minecards:…) lets you share the opening.
info.how.step4: The cards you get join your collection (duplicates stack up) and feed the statistics.
info.how.godpack: Rarely, a booster can be a “god pack”: all 5 of its cards are then full art printings, whatever their rarity.
info.minepick.title: Mine Pick
info.minepick.intro: Mine Pick is a daily mini-game: ten boosters are simulated every day with your real draw settings, and their contents are visible before you choose. Open the pack you want, turn its cards over, then keep the one you like.
info.minepick.step1: Every booster on the board is drawn exactly like a real one: same rarity table, same number of cards and the same god pack rate (five full art printings).
info.minepick.step2: The board is computed from the UTC date and your identifier: it does not change before midnight UTC, and it is yours alone.
info.minepick.step3: Three free picks a day, reset at midnight UTC. They are independent from the three free daily boosters.
info.minepick.step4: A booster you already picked from stays listed with the card you kept: that card joins the collection and feeds the Mine Pick counters of the statistics.
info.minepick.help: Mine Pick consumes no booster: it simulates the openings of the day, and only one card is kept per pick.
info.experience.title: Experience and levels
info.experience.intro: Your profile earns experience from every step of the game: the total is never spent, it only grows and moves your level up.
info.about.title: About MineCards
info.about.intro: MineCards is a collectible card game (TCG) inspired by the Minecraft universe, free to play in your browser. Three free boosters are granted every day and per expansion: each one holds 5 cards, drawn with the drop rates published below.
info.about.collection: The Genesis expansion (A1) gathers 222 cards across five rarities — Common, Rare, Super rare, Legendary and Mythic — in classic or Full Art printing. The cards you pull join your collection, where duplicates can be sold for Sparks to buy a missing card directly.
info.experience.card: Every distinct card in your collection
info.about.local: No sign-up is required and nothing is sent to a server: your collection, Sparks and statistics stay in your browser, and a save file can be exported and imported again.
info.experience.name: A custom player name
info.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
info.faq.q1: Is MineCards an official Minecraft game?
info.faq.a1: No. MineCards is an unofficial collectible card game made by enthusiasts: it is neither published nor endorsed by Mojang or Microsoft. The card artwork comes from the Minecraft universe and is credited on this page.
info.experience.levelText: Level {next} needs {base} XP, then every further level asks for {increment} XP more than the previous one.
info.faq.q2: How many free boosters can be opened each day?
info.faq.a2: Three free boosters per day and per expansion. Bonus boosters can be added through promo codes and distributions; they stack without limit until opened.
info.experience.help: The values above are read straight from the game configuration: they match the experience actually granted.
info.faq.q3: How many cards does the Genesis expansion contain?
info.faq.a3: The Genesis expansion (A1) contains 222 cards across five rarities: Common, Rare, Super rare, Legendary and Mythic, in classic printing (197 cards) or Full Art (25 cards). Every booster holds 5 cards.
info.faq.q4: Do I need an account, or need to pay, to play?
info.faq.a4: No: the game is entirely free and asks for no sign-up. An account identifier is created locally in your browser; the collection, Sparks and statistics stay on the device, and a save file can be exported and imported again.
info.faq.a5: Sparks are the game's currency: every booster you open grants a few, and duplicate cards can be sold according to their rarity. They are then used to buy a specific card straight from the collection.
info.faq.a6: Occasionally, a booster can be a godpack: all five of its cards are then Full Art printings, whatever their rarity.
